name: Team Performance
description: Multi-project Jira + git delivery analytics: git-primary task timing (first commit → develop/release merge → fixes → -DEPLOYED tag), dev-agnostic AI scope estimates (3 levels: estimate → per-dev → actual) with provider-split workers, scope-weighted throughput with multi-dev commit-share credit, routine-work detection, people/role registry with filters, git-only feature scan for repos without Jira stories, per-story outlier marks + manual times, and goals at team/role/developer level. Node sidecar — zero npm install.
